title: Hours, pay and tips at the Villa
summary: About two years, 8 pm to 3-4 am, a dollar and a half, good tips; his wife went home to the country.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: What hours did you work there in the villa? Villa?
Oh, I worked there about two years.
I mean, what time did you start at night and how late in the morning?
Well, we started at 8 o'clock and I think it was at 8 to 3 to 4 in the morning, something like that.
And they paid a dollar and a half. Yeah. Did you get any good tips? Yeah, yeah.
Pretty good tips. Good tips. Yeah.
And you went back home in Thibodeau after they closed.

Well, I just mostly went for a few. I didn't, I was living now and I'm young. Every time my wife would reinforce the child, she just had to go to the country. She never wanted to go to the hospital. Oh, yeah. Yeah.
